title: The deepest hole ever dug never left the crust
caption: About 20 years of drilling, 12 km down, and it got 0.2% of the way to the centre of the Earth.
description: The Kola Superdeep Borehole in the Soviet Arctic reached 12,262 metres in 1989-90, the deepest humans have ever drilled. Its last stretch was drilled with a bit about 21 cm across. The rock at the bottom was over 200 °C, against about 120 °C predicted, and the hole was about a third of the way through the crust beneath it. Funding was drastically cut, and drilling stopped in 1992.
